question: In which three cities of India were the High Courts first established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta, Bombay and Madras**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Calcutta, Bombay and Madras** were the first three cities in India where the High Courts were established.
 
• These High Courts were established by the Indian High Courts Act of 1861.
 
• The Calcutta High Court was the first to be established on July 1, 1862.
